data.name: Menacing Stance
data.description: At 7th level, a brawler constantly harries and distracts his enemies. While adjacent to the brawler, enemies take a -1 penalty on attack rolls and a -4 penalty on concentration checks. These penalties increase by 1 for every four levels after 7th level (to a maximum of -4 on attack rolls and -7 on concentration checks at 19th level). Creatures do not take these penalties if the brawler is dazed, helpless, staggered, stunned, or unconscious. This ability replaces armor training 2, 3, and 4 and armor mastery.
